answer_verbatim:

If your goal is to **pick a plan as an individual or family**, the most directly relevant brokers in the results are **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** and **Apollo Health Insurance**.[8][9][12] AIS says it helps you compare plans, verify your doctors and prescriptions, and choose a plan that fits your needs and budget, and it has a **5.0 Google rating** in the search results.[8][12] Apollo says it offers **free help enrolling in cost-saving plans**.[9]

If you want a broker that appears more focused on **employer or business coverage**, **NuLight Consulting** and **HUB International** are the most relevant results.[1][10] NuLight is explicitly described as a **Kansas City health insurance broker** for people starting out or managing a growing team, and HUB’s Kansas City office says it works with companies to build healthcare insurance plans.[1][10]

If you want a quick practical recommendation from the available results, I’d start with **AIS Health Insurance Advisors** for individual plan shopping, then compare it with **Apollo Health Insurance** if you want another local, independent option.[8][9][12] If you want, I can also narrow this to the **best broker for ACA plans, Medicare, self-employed coverage, or small business plans**.
